analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains at 31.0 in extreme oversold territory, closing negative for 5 consecutive days. ADX at 19.8 indicates no trend formation, with -DI (40.1) outperforming +DI (18.9), suggesting downward pressure. 4-hour RSI also enters oversold at 30.2. Given the 3x leverage nature, entering long is deferred due to amplified loss risk on sharp declines.
